HEADER: Init +5; Senses Low-light vision, sense evil; Perception +2
DEFENSE: AC 23, touch 12, flat-footed 22 (+7 armor, +1 dex, +3 shield, +3 deflect, +1 natural)
Defensive Abilities Full Withdrawal; Immune Disease, Poison, Sap; Resist Water 5
OFFENSE: Special Attacks Divine Arts (7/day, Bastion of Light [4 rounds], Goring Blade [3d6 half holy/lightning dmg, Fort Save 18 to negate 4 bonus dmg], Rage of Halone [20-ft.-line, 5d6 holy dmg, Reflex Save 18 to half], Sheltron), Holy Sword Techs (7/day, Cleansing Strike [5d8 half holy/lightning dmg & dispel]), Lay on Hands (8/day, 5d6)

Special Abilities Blessing (Cures blind, silence, & slow status), Cover (+5 AC, 15 ft.), Flash of Light (7 rounds, 10-ft.-radius, Fort Save 18 to negate Blind and Shaken), Oath Stance, Shared Defense (4 rounds, +2 AC)
1st (DC 15) - cure, enlight, fearna, phalanx, sun metal
2nd (DC 16) - cure II, effortless armor, litany of defense, paralyna, phalanx II, weapon of awe
STATISTICS: Str 18, Dex 13, Con 20, Int 10, Wis 14, Cha 18
Feats Following Step, Power Attack, Press to the Wall, Step Up, Step Up and Strike
SQ Divine Health, First Into Battle, Hold Breath, Holy Grace, Steel Shelled, Unwavering Confidence
Gear hi-potion(2), 2nd-lvl holy knight scroll, quadav knight sword +1, quadav breastplate +1, ring of protection +1
SPECIAL ABILITIES: As a full round action, quadav may retract their body into their shell. This allows them to gain DR/5 Bludgeoning. It also allows for 20% concealment. When they use this ability, they immediately fall prone, drop anything they were holding, and any item that isn't directly attached to their skin. While they are in this form, they cannot make attacks, use items, or cast spells. They must remain in this form for at least one complete round. To come out of their shell, they must spend another full round action (this does not provoke AoO).
Quadav can hold their breath underwater for a number of rounds equal to four times their Constitution score before risking drowning or suffocating.
As a quadav gets older the harder its shell gets and gains a +1 natural armor bonus.

rulesDecisions: Actor data preserves the source statblock in biography and builder flags before any Foundry runtime hydration.
Only true feats, spells, and inventory placeholders are eligible for compendium lookup during import; creature-specific special abilities remain custom generated features.
Racial hit dice are generated from the creature type and source hit dice instead of creating class levels.
Source defensive text is mapped into FFD20 trait fields while unusual FF defenses remain preserved as custom text.
Passive or toggleable special abilities that can be represented as buffs also create Foundry buff items.
Spell and spell-like ability lines create spell placeholders that should hydrate from installed FFD20/PF spell compendiums.
Skill ranks are reverse-calculated from source totals after ability modifiers, racial modifiers, size modifiers, and class-skill bonuses.
